## Goal
- Repair and publish IVX owner-chat QA so local-first sends dispatch AI without stalling at `USER_ROW_INSERTED`, and make mobile Maestro CI reliably launch the Expo app.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Use GitHub repository `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` on `main`.
- Do not hide failures with `@ts-ignore`, broad `any`, disabled checks, `continue-on-error`, or `|| true`.
- Preserve frozen lockfile enforcement and Bun `1.3.9`.
- Do not expose credentials, tokens, owner sessions, or production data.
- Avoid committing `.rork/history/main/` and generated report artifacts.
- Do not claim deployment or QA certification without SHA-matched live and CI evidence.
- Do not modify members, investors, payments, properties, credentials, production data, or owner permissions.

## Progress
### Done
- Diagnosed the original chat watchdog failure:
  - An optimistic user row reached `USER_ROW_INSERTED`, but local-first `send_and_ai` awaited `sendQueue.mutateAsync(...)` before AI dispatch.
  - Retrying durable persistence could therefore delay `AI_TRIGGER_DECISION` / `AI_MUTATION_STARTED` past the watchdog timeout.
- Implemented the local-first trigger repair:
  - Added `expo/src/modules/chat/services/ivxSendTriggerPolicy.ts`.
  - Added `expo/__tests__/ivx-send-trigger-policy.test.ts`.
  - Updated `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx` so local-first `send_and_ai` and `ai_only` start assistant execution immediately while persistence retries independently.
  - Retained persistence-first behavior for `send_only`, `attachment`, and all remote-first traffic.
  - Preserved elevated-confirmation handling before assistant execution.
- Local repair is committed locally:
  - `758bb4373196089e32eca26eafe1d44c2a0cfaf2`
  - `Improved chat responsiveness and general app reliability.`
- Passed local validation:
  - `cd expo && bun test __tests__/ivx-send-trigger-policy.test.ts __tests__/ivx-owner-ai-orchestrator.test.ts __tests__/ivx-watchdog.test.ts`
  - `cd expo && bunx tsc --noEmit --pretty false`
  - `cd expo && bun run lint`
  - Lint completed with existing warnings only.
- Investigated GitHub Actions run `30728658851` for production SHA `d1d232a65328a4a045644d838b5014a1c74e0ef7`:
  - TypeScript typecheck: success.
  - Lint: success.
  - Playwright E2E: success.
  - Maestro E2E: failure.
- Downloaded the Maestro artifact and identified the exact failure:
  - `Assertion is false: "IVX" is visible`
  - `expo/.maestro/ivx-app-launch.yaml`
  - Failed after 49.235 seconds on the launch smoke assertion.
- Identified CI launch defect:
  - `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml` used `bunx expo run:ios --configuration debug --no-bundler`.
  - The development app was launched without a running Metro/Expo development server, so Maestro could not reach the JS UI.
- Added an uncommitted workflow repair:
  - `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml` now starts `bunx expo start --dev-client --non-interactive --port 8081` in the background.
  - The workflow polls `http://127.0.0.1:8081/status` for `packager-status:running` before `expo run:ios --no-bundler`.
- Current live backend remains healthy but predates the local chat repair:
  - `https://api.ivxholding.com/health` and `/version` report production commit `d1d232a65328a4a045644d838b5014a1c74e0ef7`.
  - `POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/public/chat` timed out in the tool environment; this is not evidence of a backend regression.

### In Progress
- Complete the workflow repair validation, clean the local commit contents, then commit/push the chat and CI repairs.
- Trigger and monitor CI for the published SHA.
- Deploy and verify SHA parity between GitHub `main`, `/health`, and `/version`.
- Verify local-first chat behavior on an actual Expo/Rork runtime.

### Blocked
- The local chat repair and Metro-before-Maestro workflow repair are not pushed, deployed, or production-verified.
- Local commit `758bb4373196089e32eca26eafe1d44c2a0cfaf2` includes unwanted `.rork/history/main/` files and must be cleaned/amended before publication.
- `rork-agent logs runtime --errors` and `rork-agent logs backend --limit 100` report no logs for this project.
- No authenticated owner session is available in this tool context for direct owner-only execution testing.

## Key Decisions
- Fix the proven ordering defect at the stalled checkpoint instead of changing unrelated owner execution or production behavior.
- For local-first AI modes, dispatch from the visible optimistic row and persist independently through the retry queue.
- Keep remote-first and non-AI sends persistence-first.
- Use a pure policy helper plus unit tests to enforce persistence/AI ordering without mounting `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx`.
- Repair the actual Maestro failure by starting Metro before launching a dev-client build, rather than weakening or removing the launch assertion.
- Require CI success and production SHA parity before marking the repair complete.

## Next Steps
1. Inspect `git status --short` and `git diff --check`; remove `.rork/history/main/` from local commit `758bb4373196089e32eca26eafe1d44c2a0cfaf2`.
2. Validate the new `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml` Metro startup change and rerun focused Expo tests/typecheck/lint if necessary.
3. Amend or create a clean commit containing only:
   - `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx`
   - `expo/src/modules/chat/services/ivxSendTriggerPolicy.ts`
   - `expo/__tests__/ivx-send-trigger-policy.test.ts`
   - `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml`
4. Push the clean commit to `main`.
5. Poll the new GitHub Actions run; require TypeScript, lint, Playwright, and Maestro success.
6. Deploy the published SHA through the approved production path.
7. Verify GitHub `main` SHA equals `/health` and `/version` commit values.
8. Verify in the Expo/Rork app that a local-first send reaches `AI_TRIGGER_DECISION` and `AI_MUTATION_STARTED` without a watchdog timeout.

## Critical Context
- Production before the current repair:
  - GitHub/live backend SHA: `d1d232a65328a4a045644d838b5014a1c74e0ef7`
  - `/health`: `status: "healthy"`, `environment: "production"`, `bootTime: "2026-08-02T02:52:25.383Z"`.
  - `/version`: `ok: true`, commit `d1d232a65328a4a045644d838b5014a1c74e0ef7`.
- Current local `HEAD`:
  - `758bb4373196089e32eca26eafe1d44c2a0cfaf2`
  - Includes the intended trigger repair but also `.rork/history/main/00msb7vn40000_6rvp70gx8dg9aa46lzoc9_user.json` and `.rork/history/main/00msb7vn40001_4flfneq4g8d69i7kkndmv_assistant.json`.
- Local-first mode is enabled only if `EXPO_PUBLIC_IVX_CHAT_BACKEND_MODE` is `local`, `local_first`, or `offline`; default is `remote_first`.
- New policy returns true only for:
  - `{ localFirstChatMode: true, mode: 'send_and_ai' }`
  - `{ localFirstChatMode: true, mode: 'ai_only' }`
- Relevant watchdog checkpoint order:
  - `SEND_TAP`
  - `USER_ROW_INSERTED`
  - `AI_TRIGGER_DECISION`
  - `AI_MUTATION_STARTED`
  - `BACKEND_POST_STARTED`
  - `BACKEND_POST_FINISHED`
  - assistant render checkpoints.
- Failed Maestro run:
  - Run ID: `30728658851`
  - Job ID: `91444971768`
  - Artifact ID: `8827635725`
  - Failure: `Assertion is false: "IVX" is visible`.
- Existing workflow’s full chat flow `expo/.maestro/ivx-chat-qa-full.yaml` is not the failed launch-smoke flow; its unsupported `scroll.direction` syntax remains a separate issue if that full flow is enabled.

## Relevant Files
- `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx`: owner-chat send flow; dispatches local-first AI before durable persistence settles.
- `expo/src/modules/chat/services/ivxSendTriggerPolicy.ts`: pure local-first assistant-start policy.
- `expo/__tests__/ivx-send-trigger-policy.test.ts`: policy regression coverage.
- `expo/src/modules/chat/services/useChatSendQueue.ts`: hook around durable chat persistence.
- `expo/src/modules/chat/services/chatTransportQueue.ts`: retrying persistence queue whose wait caused the AI-dispatch delay.
- `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxLocalFirstRuntime.ts`: determines local-first versus remote-first runtime mode.
- `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxAIWatchdog.ts`: watchdog checkpoints and timeout diagnostics.
- `expo/__tests__/ivx-owner-ai-orchestrator.test.ts`: assistant lifecycle tests.
- `expo/__tests__/ivx-watchdog.test.ts`: watchdog tests.
- `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml`: uncommitted Metro startup repair before `expo run:ios --no-bundler`.
- `expo/.maestro/ivx-app-launch.yaml`: Maestro smoke flow failing at `assertVisible: "IVX"`.
- `expo/.maestro/ivx-chat-qa-full.yaml`: full chat flow with separate unsupported `scroll.direction` syntax.
- `.rork/history/main/00msb7vn40000_6rvp70gx8dg9aa46lzoc9_user.json`: unwanted file included in local commit; remove before push.
- `.rork/history/main/00msb7vn40001_4flfneq4g8d69i7kkndmv_assistant.json`: unwanted file included in local commit; remove before push.

I see it. The yellow message already gives explicit authorization to run CI and deploy through the approved production path, yet IVX responds by asking for confirmation again.

That is a real authorization-routing failure—not the desired owner workflow. The assistant should recognize the approved deployment target from the request, execute the defined pipeline, and then return SHA, CI, deployment, and health evidence.
